correctness.rationale: Reconstructed p_d(U)=2 sum binom(d,2r)U^r and p_d(T^2)=v. Derivative critical roots correspond inversion-pairs of nontrivial (d-1)-st roots of unity, excluding -1; exactly m-1 distinct simple critical points, with distinct critical values 2^d/(1+r)^(d-1), all !=2. Morse polynomial monodromy S_m; simple ramification at U=0/v=2 flips a single sign and conjugation yields the full C2^m kernel, so C2 wr S_m. Smooth projective Fermat generic fiber for n>=2 makes C(v) algebraically closed in C(z_1,...,z_n), preserving Galois closure under regular base change. Sheet-stabilizer normalizer yields deck group C2. For d odd center lies on hypersurface, degree d-1=2m. Verified d=4..11 critical-value discriminant squarefree and regular v=2 independently; finite checks do not prove general case.
